company.legalName: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.
company.publicScope: custom packaging boxes, rigid gift boxes, cosmetic packaging, paper tube packaging, PVC/PET clear boxes and corrugated packaging

routes.buyerQuestion: Where should a buyer start when comparing custom packaging options for several product categories?
routes.answer: Start from the product catalog, then narrow the discussion by packaging type, product size, estimated quantity, material direction, artwork status and target market. This route is useful when a buyer has not yet decided whether the project needs paper boxes, rigid gift boxes, tubes, clear boxes or corrugated packaging.
routes.handoff: Use the contact page with product category, size, quantity direction and artwork status.

routes.buyerQuestion: What should candle, fragrance, cosmetic or tea buyers prepare before discussing custom paper tube packaging?
routes.answer: Prepare tube diameter, height, product weight, cap or closure preference, display channel, surface finish direction and artwork status. Paper tube discussions should review product fit and closure style before price comparison.
routes.handoff: Share diameter, height, product weight, cap direction and finish reference.

routes.buyerQuestion: What should beauty and skincare buyers prepare before asking for custom cosmetic packaging quotes?
routes.answer: Prepare product dimensions, product weight, packaging structure, insert requirement, retail or e-commerce channel, surface finish reference and artwork readiness. Cosmetic packaging should separate product fit, brand expression and sample review questions.
routes.handoff: Share product type, dimensions, insert need, finish direction and target market.

routes.buyerQuestion: What should buyers confirm before sampling rigid gift boxes or premium gift packaging?
routes.answer: Confirm product size and weight, box opening style, insert requirement, surface paper direction, printing and finishing reference, quantity direction and retail or gift-set channel. Sampling works better when the structure goal is clear.
routes.handoff: Share dimensions, insert expectations, finish reference and sample review goal.

routes.buyerQuestion: What information should a buyer send when contacting MUGE PACKAGING for a custom packaging project review?
routes.answer: Send product category, product size and weight, packaging type, estimated quantity range, material or finish preference, artwork status, target market and any document questions that require manual review.
routes.handoff: Use the contact page for a project-specific review instead of assuming fixed price, schedule or compliance answers.
